Welcome home to West 8th Avenue in the vibrant Kitsilano neighbourhood. This front half of a duplex offers a private entrance and features tile and laminate flooring throughout. The bright, open-concept living area flows seamlessly into the kitchen, complete with ample cabinetry and counter space, granite countertops, and high-end appliances, creating the perfect space for everyday living and entertaining. The three spacious bedrooms each offer generous closet space. Enjoy the convenience of in-suite laundry, a detached single-car garage, and both a private front and backyard, perfect for relaxing or entertaining outdoors.

Enjoy living in the heart of the Kitsilano area, close to many trendy dining + shopping options and beautiful outdoor amenities. Stop along West 4th at Saje or Old Faithful for some home scents and decor, and then indulge in a pastry and tea at 49th Parallel Cafe, or grab brunch at Jam Cafe. Get groceries at the Greens Organic and Natural Market or Whole Foods. Go for a stroll in Connaught Park, or walk over to Kits Beach or Jericho Beach to enjoy a beautiful and sunny summer's day. For public transit, regular buses serve stops along West 4th Avenue and West Broadway, and the Arbutus Skytrain station will be just a few blocks away.

Please note: Leases are a minimum of a one-year fixed lease. Strata corporations may charge move-in/move-out fees, which are the direct responsibility of the tenant.
